reviews.title: Nice way to ease into Fasting
reviews.text: Introduced by a family member and I love this app for many reasons. 2nd time tracking my fast and this is by far an App worth having on your phone. You can custom your hours, tracking is friendly to use, appreciate the hour glass menu, also like the ability to track how you feel, log notes and it keeps history. You can see how close you are to your fasting goal. I use this along with my CGM. Well done app and worth leveraging this alongside if your monitoring your overall health.

reviews.title: This app is junk to me
reviews.text:
1) it didn’t keep me signed in! So my fast disappeared even though I logged in with the email I used and the password. 
2) when I went to add it again - it only allowed me to do minutes when I fasted 16hr 45min.

For the simple fact that it deleted my fast from yesterday this app is pure junk in my opinion. I thought I was going to love this app since I’m getting back into IF and my all time favorite IF app closed up shop last year after using it for 7 years! So back to the market I go!

reviews.title: The Best Intermittent Fasting App
reviews.text: It’s simply the best intermittent fasting app out of all. It’s simple to understand. No confusing word usage. It’s an honest app that doesn’t trick clients into paying for useless and pointless options. All other intermittent apps can’t compare to how good Sunrise is.

reviews.title: Nice but a little frustrating
reviews.text: Love the preset and custom app options. Came here from using Zero app because of their annoying subscription pop ups. In this app the interface is clean and simple to use. However, I wanted to use the notes option but cannot swipe away the keyboard to save notes. Why is the save notes button at the bottom of the screen and made inaccessible by the keyboard? Why does the vertical swipe to remove the keyboard also remove the notes screen completely and deletes my note. I cannot use this feature and it seems the developer didn't attempt this feature on an iphone. This simple thing should be fixed.

reviews.title: fasting made easy!!!

reviews.title: Flexible and easy to use-a few suggestions
reviews.text:
You can pick a fast but you can also say you’ve already started. User friendly. I love the monthly view of what I’ve fasted for history, 
I just wish for the monthly history it showed when you started and ended. I did a 48 hour and it shows the day I started with the hours I fasted and then blank until the next day I started a fast. I’d love some kind of marking to show I started, the time, and across the days in some other color-like a multi day event in outlook. I’d also love a chart that would pop up saying after this many hours I’m in ketosis, after this many hours fasting is doing this benefit…there are lots of videos which could be nice if I had time to watch them. But a quick infographic is easier. Other than that I love this ! Much more than the other one I was using

reviews.title: Great!

It’s simple to set up and minimalistic in the information it provides! I don’t need a lot of bells and whistles! I just want to know what time my fast starts and when it ends —as well as being able to view my history! This app checks all the boxes!

reviews.title: Love this app! Close to perfect
reviews.text:
I really like using this app for my 18:6 fast every day, and for sunrise->sunset fasting every March. It’s simple, clear, and I like seeing the history of my Fasts. There are just a few things I would change about the interface: - The Apple Watch complication is TOO TINY. It should use the biggest numerals that will fit. - The Apple Watch complication, the Home Screen widget, and the Live Activity should not be displaying seconds. I never care about seconds during a long fast, just hours and minutes. It takes up needless space and creates motion on the display that’s not useful. - The Live Activity bar is too wide. It stretches all the across the phone, blocking the time, but displays almost no information (90% of the bar is just black). Also, it makes accidental tapping on the bar far too easy. I finally had to disable Live Activities for this app because of this.

Update: Thanks to the developers for the prompt feedback! That’s always a very good sign a worthwhile app. Been loving it so far.

I do a 24 hour fast every week and I like the simplicity of the fast and even though I know when I started and I’ll know when a full 24 hours has passed, there’s something about checking how many hours are left that helps me get through it.

reviews.title: Easy to Use App

reviews.title: No way to edit. 😔
reviews.text: I think this will be a good intermittent fasting app, but I’m on day one, and I’m already unhappy.  I was initially setting it up, and trying to figure out how it works, and the app saved the two and three second “fasting data”.  And there’s no way to delete those mess-ups.  😔  So I’ll give it some time, hope that I get over this initial disappointment, and edit my rating.

reviews.title: Accountability at its finest…

reviews.title: Exactly what i needed
reviews.text:
My experience has been that the app serves all my needs, which are few.  I want a timer, a log of previous fasts, weight tracker w/multiple weights per day, and more generally something running in the background to keep me accountable.  This app nails it, delivering all those things and …. pretty much nothing else.  THAT IS EXACTLY WHAT I WANTED THANK YOU.  

Yeah yeah learning section yeah yeah premium blah blah blah.  Show me some ads, I don’t care that that is how you monetize it.  I barely have the app open, tops 3 times per day for a minute or two.   Start or stop the fast and two weigh ins.  

I’m doing the 36h (“monk fast”), 12h eating, 36h … bangers deal for having lost 4 of 60 lbs.  i can totally keep that up and I will assuredly continue to use the app!!!

Ya’ll da best.
Great for concentration and losing weight.
